expected_findings.quote: Page 11: All participants randomized will be analyzed according to the intervention to which they were allocated, regardless of whether they received it or not / Page 37: Patients will be excluded from the ITT analysis if the factor that leads to non-transfusion occurred before randomization and our masked treatment allocation was not compromised
expected_findings.note: The protocol states that all randomized participants are analyzed under ITT, while Appendix 4 allows some post-randomization exclusions; the analysis population needs clarification.

expected_findings.quote: We are not requesting to add this secondary outcome at Canadian sites due to the reduced reimbursement per patient in Canada
expected_findings.note: The CAPD delirium outcome will not be collected at Canadian sites, requiring clarification of how site-dependent outcome availability will be handled.

expected_findings.quote: Eligible critically ill pediatric patients who have an expected length of stay after transfusion in the ICU > 24 hours based on the best judgment of the attending ICU staff
expected_findings.note: Eligibility depends on a clinician’s judgment of anticipated ICU stay, without uniform criteria for this judgment.
Physician refusal is an exclusion criterion, but the reasons or circumstances for refusal are not specified.

expected_findings.quote: Serious Adverse Event (SAE) – an adverse event or suspected adverse reaction is considered serious if ... it results in a Grade 4 or 5 adverse reaction
expected_findings.note: The principal SAE definition emphasizes grade 4–5 events; reporting of other clinically important events should be reviewed in light of the additional specified-event list.
The NCT01977547 registration identifier is not shown in the protocol.

expected_findings.quote: Page 3: NPMODS will be monitored up to 28 calendar days or PICU discharge / Page 8: NPMODS will be monitored daily for the first seven days following randomization and then weekly until 28 calendar days or ICU discharge and through ICU stay
expected_findings.note: The wording of NPMODS follow-up differs between sections and should clarify the precise stopping point for outcome monitoring.

expected_findings.quote: The 11 events listed below will be considered reportable if they are diagnosed after an RBC transfusion regardless of grade
expected_findings.note: The reporting section refers to 11 listed adverse events, while the numbered list appears to contain 12.

expected_findings.quote: daily back-up of the full database and storage at 2 different locations will be made
expected_findings.note: Daily database backups in two locations are described, but their retention and deletion policy is not specified.
